{
 "path": "programs/task-58104120.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Frame color is present as full-height vertical rails.
    rails = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w)
             if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    frame = rails[0][1]
    width = max(c for c, color in rails if color == frame) + 1
    out = [row[:width] for row in grid]

    # Colored shapes on the right encode the colors to place in each framed cavity.
    shapes = {}
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(width, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= q[0] < h and width <= q[1] < w and q not in seen
                            and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            mr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            mc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shapes[frozenset((y - mr, x - mc) for y, x in cells)] = color

    # Full-width horizontal frame bars partition the left panel into cavities.
    start = 0
    bands = []
    for r in range(h):
        if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(width)):
            if start < r:
                bands.append((start, r))
            start = r + 1
    if start < h:
        bands.append((start, h))

    for a, b in bands:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(a, b) for c in range(width)
                 if grid[r][c] == 0]
        if not cells:
            continue
        mr = min(r for r, c in cells)
        mc = min(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = frozenset((r - mr, c - mc) for r, c in cells)
        color = shapes.get(shape)
        if color is not None:
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
